name: Site header nav and footer render and navigate
description: The persistent header shows the Arcus logo and four nav entries (Home, About, Theory, Begin Your Arc) and the footer shows its disclaimer text; a header nav link navigates correctly.

planSteps.description: Verify the site header shows the 'Arcus' wordmark and four navigation entries: 'Home', 'About', 'Theory', and 'Begin Your Arc'.
Click the 'About' link in the site header
Verify the page navigates to the About page and its hero heading reads 'Personality is a trajectory, not a type.'.
Verify the page footer contains the text 'For self-discovery and reflection. Not a clinical assessment.'.
